# Blueprint Apps & Web

> Web design studio based in Las Cruces, NM. We build custom websites and apps for businesses and churches, in English and Spanish. Estudio de diseño web en Las Cruces, NM: páginas web y apps a la medida para negocios e iglesias, en inglés y español.

- Service area: Las Cruces, NM, Doña Ana County and surrounding areas
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Contact: blueprintappsweb@gmail.com · (575) 312-5030 (phone and WhatsApp) · https://www.facebook.com/blueprintappsweb
- Response time: within 24 hours

## Services and starting prices (USD, New Mexico GRT not included)

- Express website: from $275. One landing page with call and WhatsApp buttons, ready in a few days.
- Basic website: from $500. Up to 4 sections or pages, contact form, map and hours.
- Complete website: from $950. Up to 8 pages, gallery, events or menu, in Spanish and English.
- Custom app: from $1,500 for a simple app (inventory, appointments or orders); bigger systems with users, permissions and reports are quoted by modules. Apps are web apps installed on the phone home screen (iPhone, Android) and computers; not published in the App Store or Google Play.
- Website maintenance: $35/month. Hosting, monthly check and backup, up to 2 small changes a month, WhatsApp support. App maintenance from $65/month. Domain (~$15/year) paid by the client.
- Launch offer: 30% off for the first 3 clients in exchange for featuring the project in our portfolio. Ends December 31, 2026.

Every project includes: mobile-friendly design, fast loading, basic local SEO, call/WhatsApp/map buttons, HTTPS, help connecting your domain, 2 rounds of revisions and training.

## How we work

1. Free conversation about your business or church.
2. Written proposal with price and timeline; 50% deposit to start.
3. We design and build, with progress updates.
4. Review together with 2 rounds of revisions.
5. Launch, training, and the remaining 50% is paid.
